title: polyscias willmottii
intro: Polyscias willmottii, commonly known as the 'Willmott's cheesewood' or 'Black Cheesewood', is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Pacific Islands, to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Polyscias willmottii include its potential to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of being a vasodilator and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are known for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
